groups.title: heart 心 忄
groups.note: 心 at the foot, or 忄 standing on the left: thought and feeling.

chars.story: A heart, drawn with its chambers.
chars.note: Same as the Analects: heart and mind.

chars.parts: 相 eye on a tree (sound) + 心 heart
chars.story: The heart behind an eye fixed on a tree: thinking it over.
chars.note: Also 'want to' (我想去 'I'd like to go') and 'miss' (想家).

chars.parts: 音 a note + 心 heart
chars.story: A note rising up from the heart: what you mean, an idea.
A heart caught off guard asks: how?
chars.note: Only in question words: 怎么 'how', 怎么样 'how about it'.

chars.story: A heart fresh and green: feeling.
chars.note: Also 'situation': 情况.

chars.story: The heart you were born with: your nature.
chars.note: Also 'sex', and an ending like '-ness': 重要性 'importance'.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: 亻 on the left: a person doing something.

chars.story: A person among ten, and you ask which one: what?
chars.note: Almost only in 什么 'what'.

chars.story: A person down to the root of him: the form of a body.
chars.note: Also 'body' (身体) and 'system' (体系). Traditional 體.

chars.story: A person pulling up one stake and driving in another: replace.
chars.note: Also 'era, generation': 时代, 年代 'decade'.

chars.story: The spot where a person stands: his position.
chars.note: Same as the Analects; also a polite counter for people: 一位老师.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 壬 carrying pole (sound)
chars.story: A person handed the carrying pole: appointed to the load.
chars.note: 任何 'any' is the commonest word with it.

chars.story: A person sent by an official to make things happen: cause.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'make / send'. Also 'use': 使用.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: 讠 is 言 cut down to two strokes: speech.

chars.story: Words from above: you let the other go first.
chars.note: His card is 讓 'yield': 訁 became 讠 and 襄 became 上. Now also 'let, make': 让我看看.

chars.story: Words for a person you know: recognize.
chars.note: Traditional 認: 忍 on the right became 人.

chars.story: Words counting up to ten: calculate.
chars.note: Also 'plan, scheme': 计划.

chars.story: Words that tell you what is due: should.
chars.note: Formal 'the said, that': 该公司 'the company'. Traditional 該.

groups.title: sides
groups.note: East and west, inside and outside, surface.

chars.parts: - cut down from 東, the sun behind a tree
chars.story: The sun rising behind a tree: east.
chars.note: 东西 'east-west' means 'thing'. Traditional 東.

chars.parts: - a bird settling on its nest
chars.story: A bird settling on its nest as the sun goes down: west.
A person stepping in under a frame: inside.
chars.note: His card is 內: same shape, the 入 inside now written 人.

chars.parts: 夕 evening + 卜 divining crack
chars.story: Divining at evening, out of doors: outside.
chars.note: Also 'foreign': 外国, 外语.

chars.parts: - a face in its frame, an eye in the middle
chars.story: The front of a head, the face it shows: the surface.
chars.note: After a place word: 'side': 上面, 外面. Also 'noodles' (麵).

groups.title: counting
groups.note: Numbers, order and times.

chars.story: Three strokes: three.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: A yoke with two collars: two.
chars.note: 两 counts things (两个人); 二 is the numeral (二十). Traditional 兩.

chars.story: Bamboo slips stacked in order, eldest to youngest: first, second, third.
chars.note: Before a number: 第三 'third'.

chars.story: A breath, a yawn, then the next one: next.
chars.note: His Analects card. Mostly a counter for times: 三次 'three times'.

groups.title: because and from
groups.note: Where a thing comes from, and why.

chars.story: A man lying on a mat: because of him, the dent in it.

chars.parts: - a shoot coming up out of a field
chars.story: A shoot rising out of the field: that is where it comes from.
chars.note: Also 'by': 由他决定 'it is for him to decide'.

chars.story: One person following another out of the gate: from there.
chars.note: His card is 從 'follow': two 人 replaced the old shape. Now mostly 'from': 从北京来.

groups.title: and, or, etc.
groups.note: Joining a list, and ending one.

chars.parts: - two figures standing side by side
chars.story: Two figures standing side by side: and also.
chars.note: Before a negative: 'not at all': 并不难. Simplifies 並 and 併.

chars.story: A hand catching hold of the person ahead: reach.
chars.note: 以及 is a formal 'and'.

chars.parts: 戈 halberd + 口 walled place + 一 ground
chars.story: A halberd guarding one walled place: this one or that one?
Bamboo slips lined up at the temple office, waiting their turn: wait.
chars.note: After a list: 'and so on'. Also 'rank, grade': 等级.

groups.title: degree words
groups.note: How much: very, more, only, more than.

chars.story: A step dug in hard and stubborn: very much so.
chars.note: Before an adjective it is often a plain link: 他很高 'he is tall'.

chars.parts: - a hand pushing a frame a notch further
chars.story: A frame pushed one more notch along: even more.
chars.note: Before an adjective: 更好 'better'. Also 'change': 更新.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 八 two legs
chars.story: A mouth on two little legs: just one, only.
chars.note: Also a counter for animals and for one of a pair (隻).

chars.story: Two people side by side, measured against each other: compare.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'side by side'. A 比 B 高 'A is taller than B'.

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Markers of time and of the doer.

chars.story: A coil that has already closed itself off: done, already.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Lookalikes: 己 self, 已 already, 巳 snake.

chars.parts: 丬 half tree + 夕 meat + 寸 hand
chars.story: A hand on the meat, about to serve it: will.
chars.note: His card is 將 'about to': 爿 became 丬. Also 'general' (将军) and a formal 把.

chars.story: An eye keeps watching the sheep: still going on.
chars.note: After a verb: 他笑着说 'he said, smiling'. Also 'touch, wear': 着火 'catch fire'.

chars.story: An old man out in the sun, the one who does the work.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. After a verb: the person who does it: 读者 'reader'.

groups.title: this 此
groups.note: 此 is 'this'; with 二 under it, 'some'.

chars.story: A foot stopped right beside a person: here, this.
chars.note: The written 这: 因此 'therefore', 此时 'at this moment'.

chars.story: This one, plus a couple more: some.

groups.title: silk 纟 糸
groups.note: 纟 is twisted silk thread: tying and joining.

chars.story: Silk joined into a gift and handed over: give.
chars.note: Also 'for, to': 给他打电话 'phone him'. Traditional 給.

chars.story: Silk tied in a lucky knot: tie.
chars.note: Traditional 結.

chars.story: A thread hanging from the skein, tying one thing to the next: relate.
chars.note: Also 'department' at a university. Simplifies 係 and 繫.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: 木 on the left or below: wood and trees.

chars.story: A sheep carved from wood: a model, the manner of a thing.
chars.note: Traditional 樣.

chars.story: A tree with its round fruit hanging.
chars.note: Also 'result': 结果, 效果.

chars.story: An eye and a tree, looking at each other.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'appearance, photo': 照相.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: 口 inside the shape: speech, a gap, a thing held.

chars.parts: 人 lid + 一 one + 口 mouth
chars.story: A lid closing down over a mouth: the two join.
In the dark of evening you call out your name.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: Words flying from the mouth as straight as arrows: you know.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

groups.title: gate 门
groups.note: 门 is 門 cut down to three strokes.

chars.story: A mouth at the gate: ask.
chars.note: His card is 問: 門 became 门.

chars.story: The sun shining through the gap in the gate: between.
chars.note: His card is 間 'interval': 門 became 门. Also 'room': 房间.

groups.title: rising and going
groups.note: Getting up, standing, going in, going off.

chars.story: You yourself spring up and start to run: rise.
chars.note: After a verb, 'up' or 'begin': 想起 'recall'.

chars.parts: - a man standing on the ground
chars.story: A man standing firm on the ground: stand.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'at once': 立即.

chars.parts: - two strokes, like a wedge going in
chars.story: A wedge driven in at a point: go into.
chars.note: Lookalike: 人 person, 入 go into, 八 eight.

chars.parts: 土 earth + 厶 a twist
chars.story: Feet leaving the ground behind them: go.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'leave'. Modern 去 is 'go to': 去北京.

groups.title: high, long, heavy
groups.note: Size you can feel.

chars.parts: - a tall tower on a base
chars.story: A tall tower with its roof and gate: high.
chars.note: Also 'tall': 他很高.

chars.parts: - an old man with long hair blowing
chars.story: An old man with long hair streaming in the wind: long.
chars.note: His card is 長: cut down to four strokes. Also 'grow' and 'chief': 增长, 市长.

chars.parts: - a man bent under a bundle
chars.story: A man bent under a heavy bundle: heavy.
chars.note: Also 'again': 重新, 重复.

groups.title: true and right
groups.note: What is real, straight and reasonable.

chars.parts: 十 ten + 目 eye + 一 shelf + 八 stand
chars.story: Ten eyes on a stand, all looking: it is true.
A foot stopped square on the line: upright.
chars.note: Before a verb: 'just now': 正在 '-ing'. The left of 政.

chars.story: The veins running through jade: the grain of things, their reason.
chars.note: Also 'manage, put in order': 管理, 处理.

groups.title: making and changing
groups.note: Control, build, produce, transform.

chars.story: A knife trimming a branching tree into shape: control.
chars.note: Also 'make': 制造, 制作. Simplifies 製 too.

chars.parts: 廴 long stride + 聿 brush
chars.story: A brush draws the plan, long strides pace out the walls: build.
Standing at the foot of the cliff where things are born: produce.
chars.note: Traditional 產: 生 'birth' at the foot was dropped.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 匕 person upside down
chars.story: A person standing, then upside down: transformed.
chars.note: After a noun: '-ize': 现代化 'modernize'.

groups.title: places
groups.note: Market, district, a big open place.

chars.story: A cloth awning with a roof over it: a stall in the market.
chars.note: Also 'city': 城市, 市长 'mayor'.

chars.story: A box marked off with a cross: a district.
chars.note: Traditional 區: the three 口 inside became one cross.

chars.parts: 土 earth + 𠃓 sun's rays (cut down)
chars.story: Open earth in the sun where crowds gather: a large place.
chars.note: Also a counter for games and shows: 一场比赛. Traditional 場.

groups.title: world and life
groups.note: The world you live in, and being alive.

chars.story: Three tens joined: thirty years, a lifetime, the world.
chars.note: Also 'generation, lifetime'.

chars.story: Water still on the tongue: alive.
chars.note: Also 'work, job': 干活 'do work'.

groups.title: writing
groups.note: Marks, headings and what they show.

chars.parts: - a man with a pattern on his chest
chars.story: A man with a pattern drawn on his chest: marks, writing.
chars.note: Also 'culture' and 'language': 中文, 英文.

chars.story: What is at the head of the page: its topic.
chars.note: Traditional 題: 頁 became 页.

chars.parts: 衣 clothes, split + 龶 fur
chars.story: A fur coat worn on the outside, for all to see: show.
chars.note: Also 'table, form' and 'watch': 手表 (錶).

groups.title: cow 牛
groups.note: 牛 squeezed onto the left: cattle.

chars.story: The cow kept at the temple: a special one.
Cattle and all the countless other things in the world: things.

groups.title: strength 力
groups.note: 力 is a flexed arm, or a plough.

chars.story: An arm bent and flexed: strength.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: Strength with a shouting mouth behind it: add more.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

groups.title: lean-to 广
groups.note: 广 is a roof with one wall: a shelter.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 廿 twenty + 又 hand
chars.story: A hand pacing out the span under a lean-to: its degree, its extent.
chars.note: Also 'degree' of heat and angle: 三十度.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 丷 and a line (cut down from 應)
chars.story: Someone calls under the lean-to and you answer: respond.
chars.note: In 应该, 应当: 'should'. Traditional 應: the heart 心 at the foot was dropped.

groups.title: tap 攵
groups.note: 攵 is a hand holding a stick: doing, making someone do.

chars.parts: 孝 elder and child + 攵 tap
chars.story: Tapping a child under an elder's eye: teach.
chars.note: Also 'religion': 宗教, 教会 'church'.

chars.parts: 娄 piled up (cut down) + 攵 tap
chars.story: Tapping each thing in the pile in turn: count them, a number.
chars.note: His card is 數 'count' (still a sense): the left side was cut down.

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: 辶 is a road under the feet.

chars.story: A head going on ahead along the road: the way.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'the Way'. Mostly 'road', and 'say' in 知道, 报道.

chars.story: Walking along a passage open at both ends: through.
chars.note: Also 'notify': 通知.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: 女 is a woman kneeling.

chars.story: A woman kneeling with her hands folded.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: The woman over there, also one of us: she.
chars.note: 他 'he', 她 'she', 它 'it'. 她 is a modern invention.

groups.title: hand 手
groups.note: 手 is a hand; squeezed to the left it is 扌.

chars.story: A hand with its fingers spread.
chars.note: After a word: a skilled person: 歌手 'singer'.

chars.story: A hand that grips the handle and raises it: raise.
chars.note: Also 'mention': 提到.

groups.title: fire 灬
groups.note: 灬 is fire spread out at the foot.

chars.story: Sparks of fire under a scorch mark: a dot.
chars.note: Also 'o'clock' (三点) and 'order' food. Traditional 點: 黑 became 占.

chars.parts: 月 meat + 犬 dog + 灬 fire
chars.story: Dog meat roasting over the fire: of course it is thus.
chars.note: Mostly inside words; after an adjective '-ly': 突然 'suddenly'.

groups.title: grain 禾
groups.note: 禾 is a stalk of grain with its head bent.

chars.story: Grain sorted into heaps, one kind to a heap: kind.
chars.note: Also 'seed' and 'to plant'. Traditional 種: 重 became 中.

chars.story: A knife cutting ripe grain: profit.
chars.note: Same as the Analects; also 'sharp'.

groups.title: moon 月
groups.note: 月 on the right is the moon: time passing.

chars.story: The moon coming round to its phase again: a period.
chars.note: Also 'expect': 期待.

chars.story: Sun and moon together: bright.
chars.note: Also 'clear' and 'next': 明天 'tomorrow'.

groups.title: shell 贝
groups.note: 贝 is a cowrie shell, the old money.

chars.story: Shells laid by for the next time: savings, resources.
chars.note: Traditional 資: 貝 became 贝.

chars.story: One mouth counted for one shell: a member on the roll.
chars.note: After a word: the one who does it: 演员 'actor'. Traditional 員.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Pictures that do not break down.

chars.parts: - lightning striking out of a cloud
chars.story: A bolt of lightning striking down: electric.
chars.note: Traditional 電: the rain 雨 on top was dropped.

chars.parts: - a frame strung with crossed cords
chars.story: A frame strung with crossed cords: a net.
chars.note: His card is 網: 纟 silk and 亡 were dropped, leaving the old picture.

chars.parts: - four strokes cut down from 無
chars.story: 無 stripped down to four strokes, almost nothing left: none.
chars.note: His card is 無 'have no'. Formal for 没有.

sentences.en: You ought to have been more careful.
There's nothing I can do about it.
I do want to go to Italy.

sentences.zh: 事情真的已经了结了吗？
她不知道该和他说些什么。
sentences.en: She didn't know what to say to him.

sentences.zh: 如果没有电，那我们生活会怎样?
sentences.en: What would our lives be like without electricity?

sentences.zh: 但是我那次到中国有家人等着我。
sentences.en: But when I arrived in China that time, I had a family waiting for me.

sentences.zh: 你只要问他想不想加入我们就可以了。
sentences.en: You have only to ask him if he'd like to join us.

sentences.zh: 他的工作工资很高，工作时间也相当理想。
sentences.en: His salary is high, and the hours are pretty good, too.
